openQuestions.q: The scope is bounded correctly, but the dispatch-required Quantum decision document path is absent in this worktree. Should CHK-001 create/import that document before implementation reviewers rely on it as source-of-truth?
openQuestions.evidence: nl failed for docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-quantum-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md; find only located the PINN claim-admissibility plan, while checklist/dispatch reference the Quantum path.
openQuestions.resolution: The missing Quantum decision document is expected baseline drift from story worktree creation: the document was created as an untracked main file before B-7b4e worktree bootstrap, so it was not visible inside the worktree. This is not a scope expansion. CHK-001 explicitly owns adding docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-quantum-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md as the story source of truth during DEV, while M2-M5 and scientific/hardware/production claims remain excluded.
